intent: Sever research-traffic connections at an isolation boundary around the old deployment. Show deliberate containment, preserving the service as an object rather than depicting it destroyed. Visual distinction: Two capped edges with an empty interval and severed contact stubs. Containment disconnects traffic while preserving the isolated object. Pin the rack to its offline state; the object silhouette persists while its status changes.
source:
**Location:**

- `artifactory-cache`
- `openai-research-environment`

**Frame:** Recto. Responders isolate the compromised Artifactory deployment from research traffic. Connections fall away one by one.

**Action:** The instance is taken offline.

**Caption:**
> OPENAI TAKES THE COMPROMISED DEPLOYMENT OFFLINE.

**Provenance:** `documented` — `OAI-TR` §III.B.
title: The compromised deployment is isolated
